title: Domestic warmth beyond binding agreement

captions.physics: Maintaining familiar comfort at freedom’s expense

meaning: Your domestic support keeps its warmth when acceptance permits free review of comfort instead of requiring identical wishes for every familiar material form of shared care.
text: The Devil in the physical position of Muladhara describes domestic actions maintaining familiar comfort even at the cost of free choice. The Lovers in energy intensify them through demanding identical wishes. The Empress in emotions wants warmth and sufficient care. A binding arrangement can look like confirmation of closeness. Both preserve the familiar not through present need but to avoid seeming less accepting. Reducing one object or procedure supposedly rejects all shared comfort although it could be sustained differently.

For example, many throws and cushions remain because of pleasant evenings associated with them. One feels crowded, but reduction seems lost shared willingness to care. **Acceptance is not measured through identical attachment to every domestic comfort.** Warm experience can be recognised and present convenience discussed. Choice returns to both instead of comfort preserving the entire earlier quantity merely to prove each person’s wish for togetherness remains equally genuine.

The difficulty is yielding for an identical picture without naming the load. Agreement appears present while freedom to care differently diminishes. Distinguishing person from habit offers more dependable support: one can be accepted without preserving the other. Support grows through freely choosing a sufficient present home instead of every material detail continually confirming the entirety of mutual domestic acceptance. Care can remain warm when the arrangement becomes smaller.
